stem.text: A student immersed a plant tissue in solution S.
For the next 30 minutes, the student used a microscope to observe the cells in the plant tissue.
During this time, the cytoplasm of the cells shrunk and no longer pushed up against the cell wall. In many cells, a space appeared between the cytoplasm and the cell wall.
Which statements are correct conclusions from these observations?

items: The water potential in solution S was more negative than the water potential in the cytoplasm of the cells at the start of the experiment.
Without a cell wall to provide support, it is likely that many of the cells would have burst.
The clear space between the cell wall and the cytoplasm of many of the cells was filled with air.
